name: akou
longDescription:
akou turns audio into text on your own server. A program uploads a file, gets a job id back at once, and reads the result with text, language, word and segment times and speaker labels, by long-poll, by an event feed or by a signed webhook. It also answers the OpenAI transcription endpoint (POST /v1/audio/transcriptions), so clients that speak it work with no code on their side.

Results come as text, JSON, SRT or VTT. Each program gets its own API key, and a web page shows the job queue, the keys, the models and the settings. The default fast preset runs NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 on the CPU, with Nemotron speaker labels when a job asks for them; the models download on the first job, about 3 GB.

akou is also a call recorder for macOS; this app is its server mode, the same core in Docker.
description: Self-hosted transcription server with speaker labels, SRT and VTT output, and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
